name: custom-auth
description: Generic provider for user-configured HTTP AI endpoints (IR <-> vendor wire via translator submodules), key via core-auth.
author: intisy

scripts.build:deps: npm --prefix core install && npm --prefix core run build && npm --prefix core-ir install && npm --prefix core-ir run build && node core/teavm-build.mjs --java-dir . --module :teavm-custom --out src/generated/custom-provider.teavm.js && npm --prefix core-auth install && npm --prefix core-auth run build
scripts.build: npm run build:deps && npx esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:@intisy-ai/core --external:@intisy-ai/core-auth --external:@intisy-ai/core-ir --external:sync-bridge --outfile=dist/index.js && npx esbuild src/handler.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:@intisy-ai/core --external:@intisy-ai/core-auth --external:@intisy-ai/core-ir --external:sync-bridge --outfile=dist/handler.js && npx esbuild src/driver.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:@intisy-ai/core --external:@intisy-ai/core-auth --external:@intisy-ai/core-ir --external:sync-bridge --outfile=dist/driver.js && npx esbuild src/plugin.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:@intisy-ai/core --external:@intisy-ai/core-auth --external:@intisy-ai/core-ir --external:sync-bridge --outfile=dist/plugin.js
